mapper.select: select id, name, price, stock, sales, category_id, image_url from product order by id
select id, name, price, stock, sales, category_id, image_url from product where category_id = #{categoryId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into product(name, price, stock, sales, category_id, image_url) values (#{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{categoryId}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.update: update product set name = #{name}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, category_id = #{categoryId}, image_url = #{imageUrl} where id = #{id}
